title: Middo Business Logic Flaw Hunt
purpose: Prove or break domain/product rules: who may do what, when, under which status, cutoff, role, and commercial policy — independent of UI polish.

methodology.goal: Find flaws where the product allows or denies outcomes that violate Middo’s intended business rules.
not_in_scope: Pure concurrency race proofs (covered in application-logic plan except where race changes business outcome)
approach: Derive expected rules from Support classes + role routes, not from UI copy
For each rule: happy path, boundary, negative (should refuse), and privilege escalation
Cross-role: same action as corporate vs kitchen vs delivery vs operation vs admin
Cross-channel: web Livewire vs corporate mobile API must enforce the same rule
Record oracle: DB status fields, wallet ledger, box logs, partner payables — not toast text alone
methodology.pass_criteria: Every case has Expected Outcome + Observable Oracle. Fail if actual violates oracle.

severity.P0: Money loss, free meals, unauthorized cancel/refund, partner overpay, custody theft

cases.title: Place order for today before cutoff succeeds
preconditions: Clock < 15:28 Dhaka on delivery day D
cases.expected: Order created with order_status=pending
cases.flaw_hypothesis: Cutoff applied too early or wrong timezone

cases.title: Place order for today at/after cutoff fails
steps: Attempt place order for D (web + API)
cases.expected: Rejected on both channels
oracle: Same error class on web and API

preconditions: Pending order with amount_paid=A, unpaid residual R>0
cases.expected: cancelled; wallet credited A (not A+R)

cases.title: Cancel after cutoff fails while still pending
preconditions: Pending order, now past cutoff for delivery date
cases.expected: Rejected; order remains pending

cases.title: Cancel non-pending statuses always denied for corporate
cases.expected: Denied for every non-pending status even before cutoff

cases.title: Edit order is disabled (cancel+recreate policy)

cases.expected: Update hard-disabled; no silent partial edit

cases.title: Cutoff uses Asia/Dhaka even if server TZ differs

cases.expected: Allow/deny matches Dhaka wall clock, not UTC

cases.title: Exactly at cutoff is closed (>=)
cases.expected: Both denied

cases.title: COD allowed for single-day cart when prepay not forced
cases.expected: Order created; charge at checkout = 0; residual due at delivery

cases.title: COD denied when prepayment required (active+new > 3 → 50%)
preconditions: Corporate already has enough active dates that projected > 3

cases.title: Receiver ≠ profile forces 100% prepay (wins over 50%)

cases.title: Multi-date cart COD policy consistency web vs API

cases.expected: Document actual rule; both channels identical; if multi-date COD with 0 prepaid is allowed, flag as policy flaw
oracle: Same payment_method and amount_paid pattern on both channels

preconditions: Same cart shape on web and API

suites.name: Daily quantity cap & meal grouping policy

cases.title: Max 5 meals per user per delivery date across non-cancelled orders
preconditions: User already ordered 4 for date D
cases.expected: qty 2 rejected; qty 1 accepted (total 5)

cases.title: Cancelled orders free daily capacity
steps: Cancel one qty-2 order before cutoff
cases.expected: Capacity restored

cases.title: Auto-group: same menu+date+area, kitchen null, capacity <=10
cases.expected: Joins existing group

cases.title: Auto-group: overflow creates new group
cases.expected: New group created; does not push first group over 10

cases.title: Single order qty > 10 policy
preconditions: max_order_qty may block at 5 — use staff/manual path or temporarily raise daily limit in test to isolate grouper
cases.expected: Business decision: either hard-reject OR document solo over-capacity group as accepted risk
oracle: Flag if over-capacity group created silently
cases.flaw_hypothesis: qty>10 creates oversized group with no reject

cases.title: Manual regroup by ops does not silently violate same-menu/area/capacity policy
preconditions: Two orders different menus or areas
cases.expected: Either blocked OR explicit ops override logged; document intentional exception

cases.title: Package-scheduled days count toward daily 5-meal limit
preconditions: Subscription scheduled creating pending package orders on D totaling 3
cases.expected: Rejected if total would exceed 5; accepted if within 5
oracle: Sum all non-cancelled orders for D
cases.flaw_hypothesis: Package days not counted until schedule creates orders — verify after schedule

cases.title: Checkout finalize requires valid OTP
steps: Submit checkout without OTP / wrong OTP / expired (>300s)
cases.expected: No order created

cases.title: Package subscribe (balance & gateway) requires OTP
steps: Complete payment path then wrong OTP
cases.expected: No subscription completed

cases.title: Same mobile concurrent checkouts OTP collision
steps: Start two checkouts for same mobile; consume OTP on first
cases.expected: Second cannot reuse consumed OTP; no double charge
oracle: At most one successful finalize per OTP
cases.flaw_hypothesis: Single cache key per mobile allows cross-session steal/collision

suites.name: Kitchen accept / pack / dispatch business rules

cases.title: Dispatch requires exactly order.quantity Middo boxes at kitchen
cases.expected: Only exact qty succeeds → packed + dispatched_at set

steps: Select box at warehouse / other kitchen / already on another order
cases.expected: Rejected

steps: Ops assign kitchen to unassigned group

cases.title: Ops reassign / clear kitchen after packing mid-flight
steps: Ops reassign group to another kitchen or clear
cases.expected: Business decision: must either block or leave consistent custody + status; document flaw if packed order points at wrong kitchen while boxes elsewhere
cases.flaw_hypothesis: Reassign after pack without reverting status / box custody

cases.title: Accept does not require area match beyond group key
steps: Kitchen outside area accepts unassigned group
cases.expected: Document if any kitchen can accept any unassigned group — policy check

suites.name: Delivery accept / deliver / COD settlement policy

cases.title: One non-cancelled package per user per target_month

cases.title: Default omitted weekdays Fri+Sat unless overridden

cases.title: Skip pending day before cutoff refunds day amount and ungroups
